name: Camera photo capture
description: Takes a photo with the system camera interface, with a clear message where no camera exists (such as the Simulator) and a library fallback.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to take photos you add in the app.

usage: Present `CameraCaptureButton(image: $photo)`; it shows the system camera in a full-screen cover and returns a `UIImage`. Where `CameraCapture.isAvailable` is false (Simulator, some iPads) it is disabled with an explanation; offer photos-picker as the alternative. Rewrite `NSCameraUsageDescription` for the app. For a custom camera UI (scanning, filters), build on AVCaptureSession instead.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify camera-capture` on a Mac with XcodeGen.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
